resources.string: Harvests feed your heroes; adventures fund your village and speed up construction. Send an expedition before leaving, or keep exploring.
Optional tasks · reset in %1$s. No streak to maintain: play at your own pace. Each reward also includes 12 books and village coins.
Harvest crops, collect produce or taxes, or deliver workshop orders.
Win battles, gather on the campaign map, complete quick raids, or bring expeditions home.
Recruit or improve heroes, upgrade village buildings, or study village research.
Claim all three tasks: 2 invitations, 8 crystals, 3 minutes of construction work and 200 coins.
Give your heroes a village duty. They remain available for combat. One hero per duty; change duties freely. Matching roles grant an extra 5%. Levels and stars improve the bonus up to 25%.
Boost crop, orchard and ranch income, and passive food production. Rangers, healers and summoners excel here.
Boost workshop income, and passive timber, stone and ore production. Guardians, engineers and duelists excel here.
Boost home income and passive book production. Bards, mages and rogues excel here.
Your active combat team also helps expeditions: +%1$d scouting power, −%2$d%% travel time. Travel time is fixed at departure; heroes remain available.
Also returns %1$d food, %2$d ore, %3$d books, %4$d crystals and %5$d invitation(s) for your heroes.
